mission: Owner 2026-11-03: identified mappings 4456, 4423 and 4356 (refused by the collector's artwork check) as correct parallels (prints 5862, 5864, 5872) and suspects the collector compares the listing photo with the base artwork. The collector compares with card_prints.image_url of the mapped print (snkrdunk_collector/collect.py).
